parameters.positivePrompt: A continuous architectural transformation from this exact empty 3D CAD cutaway into a photorealistic Japanese home cafe operated by a married couple. First second retains original CAD. Over next 3 seconds materials and occupancy gently dissolve into realistic life without moving architecture. Then show three pairs of customers sitting correctly on existing chairs at three separate tables, sipping coffee and tasting cake, quietly conversing. One apron-wearing spouse prepares coffee at the rear kitchen counter; the other serves a tray along the clear aisle. Preserve all FOUR tables, eight chairs, stairs, split-level platform, black railings, kitchen island sink on RIGHT, walls, windows and five-blade fan. TV shows calm coast. Upper floor is hidden ONLY for visualization: invisible ceiling must BLOCK overhead sunlight. Soft lateral window light and warm interior lights only, no sunlight through missing ceiling. Slow smooth camera push-in of ONLY 5 percent total, same overhead orientation, no orbit or cuts. People natural scale and anatomy, pelvis on seats, feet on correct local floor level. No geometry morphing, added furniture, text or logos. Warm realistic home cafe, restrained natural motion.
